question: Patayat Sahu, who was conferred the Padma Shri in the year 2023 by the President of India for his significant contribution in the field of medicinal plants in agriculture, is from________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Patayat Sahu**, who was conferred the **Padma Shri** in the year **2023** by the President of India for his significant contribution to the field of medicinal plants in agriculture, is from **Odisha**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Patayat** **Sahu**:​

 
 
• A **farmer** and **Ayurveda** practitioner from **Nandol **village in **Kalahandi **district, **Sahu** has nurtured about, **3000 medicinal plants** without the use of **chemicals and fertilizers**.
 
• The 65-year-old, who also works as a **traditional healer**, has been lauded for his efforts in promoting** natural healthcare practices**.
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** praised **Sahu** in his monthly radio program **‘Mann Ki Baat’**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The Government announced six names for Padma Vibhushan, nine for Padma Bhushan, and 91 for Padma Shri Award.
 
• Dilip Mahalanabis (Medicine), Samajwadi Party founder and former UP CM Mulayam Singh Yadav (Public Affairs), and architect Balakrishna Doshi have been picked to be awarded Padma Vibhushan posthumously.
 
• Among the nine people to be awarded Padma Bhushan are S L Bhyrappa in Literature; Kumar Mangalam Birla in Trade & Industry; Deepak Dhar in Science & Engineering; Vani Jairam in Art; Swami Chinna Jeeyar in Others – Spiritualism
 
• Four people, who have been selected for Padma Shri from Odisha, are Shri Maguni Charan Kuanr (Art), Shri Antaryami Mishra (Literature & Education), Ms. Krishna Patel (Art), Shri Patayat Sahu (Others - Agriculture).
